mapper.select: select "totalOrder" as type, COUNT(*) as count from attraction_order where order_state in ('20','80') UNION ALL select "todayOrder" as type, COUNT(*) as count from attraction_order where order_state in ('20','80') and DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() UNION ALL select "totalPrice" as type,IFNULL(SUM(total_price),0) as count from attraction_order where order_state in ('20','80') UNION ALL select "todayPrice" as type,IFNULL(SUM(total_price),0) as count from attraction_order where order_state in ('20','80') and DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT t.id AS typeId, t.type_name AS typeName, IFNULL(COUNT(o.id), 0) AS orderCount FROM attraction_type t LEFT JOIN attraction_info i ON i.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN attraction_order o ON o.attraction_id = i.id AND o.order_state IN ('20', '80') GROUP BY t.id, t.type_name ORDER BY t.type_name;

WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT CURDATE() AS d UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM dates WHERE d > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS total_amount FROM dates d LEFT JOIN attraction_order o ON DATE(o.create_time) = d.d AND o.order_state IN ('20', '80') GROUP BY d.d ORDER BY d.d;

select "totalOrder" as type, COUNT(*) as count from hotel_order t1 left join hotel_info t2 on t1.hotel_id = t2.id where t2.creator = #{userId} and t1.order_state in ('20','80') UNION ALL select "todayOrder" as type, COUNT(*) as count from hotel_order t1 left join hotel_info t2 on t1.hotel_id = t2.id where t2.creator = #{userId} and t1.order_state in ('20','80') and DATE(t1.create_time) = CURDATE() UNION ALL select "totalPrice" as type,IFNULL(SUM(total_price),0) as count from hotel_order t1 left join hotel_info t2 on t1.hotel_id = t2.id where t2.creator = #{userId} and t1.order_state in ('20','80') UNION ALL select "todayPrice" as type,IFNULL(SUM(total_price),0) as count from hotel_order t1 left join hotel_info t2 on t1.hotel_id = t2.id where t2.creator = #{userId} and t1.order_state in ('20','80') and DATE(t1.create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT t1.id, t1.htoel_name AS hotelName, COUNT( t2.id ) AS orderCount FROM hotel_info t1 LEFT JOIN hotel_order t2 ON t1.id = t2.hotel_id AND t2.order_state IN ( '20', '80' ) WHERE t1.creator = #{userId} GROUP BY t1.id ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE days AS ( SELECT CURDATE() AS d UNION ALL SELECT DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM days WHERE d > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ), order_sum AS ( SELECT DATE(o.create_time) AS d, SUM(o.total_price) AS amount FROM hotel_order o JOIN hotel_info h ON o.hotel_id = h.id WHERE h.creator = #{userId} AND o.order_state in ('20','80') AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ) SELECT days.d AS stat_date, IFNULL(order_sum.amount, 0) AS total_amount FROM days LEFT JOIN order_sum ON days.d = order_sum.d ORDER BY stat_date;
